q: What is the carbon footprint of a coaching centre per student?
title: Coaching centre emissions per student
short: For a coaching centre, the bills are mainly electricity for ACs, lights and projectors, plus any diesel genset. Divide the year's Scope 1 and 2 by enrolled students. Student travel to class, often the largest share, is commuting in Scope 3.

p: Live online batches move energy to students' homes and to cloud services. Count the cloud bill in Scope 3.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
